Notes on what I found and didn't:

- 
Town of Oakville's fall recreation and culture program registration opened Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m., with program options available to browse online starting August 4.
 The booking page itself (a login-gated PerfectMind calendar) doesn't print day/time/price for the preschool sessions in the snippets I could read.
- 
Children must be the age required for the level they are taking by the program start date, and children who are five years-old do not need to complete all preschool levels before moving to the Swimmer programs.
 No specific fall day/time/price was visible on the page.
- 
For children between 3 to 5 years old, the YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons program introduces basics of swimming, with eight levels: Splashers, Bubblers, Bobbers, Floaters, Gliders, Divers, Surfers, and Jumpers.
 No fall day/time/price was posted on the page I read.
- 
At Goldfish Swim School – Oakville, lessons are designed for children ages 4 months through 12 years old, all within an indoor setting.
 No specific fall schedule or pricing was on the page.

All three are real, current programs for the preschool age band — just missing the day/time/price detail on the pages I could access today.
